moni.quest.1C861E0C62D5B97D.description2: (Unique multi mechanic code taken from the Cosmic Frontiers team with Caitlynn's gracious permission.)
moni.quest.7DE2C9292A09FC76.description2: One major draw is that &6Moon Turf&r, which makes up the surface of the Moon, is an efficient means of obtaining &9Deuterium&r. It will be useful for producing &9Microversium&r, &9Tritium&r, plasmas from fusion, and crystallizing &6Dilithium&r.
moni.quest.62C85A1F451C4855.description3: With a &3Tier Two Rocket&r you can make it to &eMars&r. Mars has &6Scheelite&r, &6Arsenopyrite&r, &6Carnotite&r, &6Borax&r, and veins of liquid &9Fluorine&r.
moni.quest.4672EE66D51C32FF.description1: The &9Oxygen Loader&r is used to load Oxygen into your Space Suit, making it usable for exploring the great beyond.
moni.quest.7DE2C9292A09FC76.description4: Space exploration isn't mandatory in this pack, so if you don't feel like exploring space with &bAd Astra&r, then you can centrifuge &9Hydrogen&r for &eDeuterium&r instead.
moni.quest.0E9B96B17D140B99.description1: Also known as PEEK, this plastic will be used for coating cables of &4UHV&r+ voltage and as an incredibly fast item pipe.
moni.quest.6DC635766CD40FFF.description2: With these coils, you can now smelt &6Tantalum Carbide&r, required for the &3Alloy Blast Smelter&r.
moni.quest.4C0BCA64D5B409F2.description2: With this you can make &aUEV &6Energy Hatches&r, unlocking the &3Dimensonal Superassembler&r, &3Transdimensional Energy Singularity&r, and the most efficient recipe for &6Optical Circuits&r using &6Photonic SoCs&r.
moni.quest.1E36AFB19932C805.description2: If you haven't made it already, you will need &6Polyethyl Cyanoacrylate&r.
moni.quest.7DE2C9292A09FC76.description5: Just keep in mind that it's much less rewarding to skip this and you'll need lots of Hydrogen to compensate, although you won't need too much for the first &3Microverse Projector&r.
moni.quest.3B3F46345D39CAE2.description3: The dusts need to be &2bathed in Hydrochloric Acid to make Tungstic Acid, then electrolyzed&r to get to the Tungsten, which then needs to be cooked in the EBF for Tungsten Ingots.
moni.quest.1229234A71CE0A99.description2: &6Copper&f: Two primary sources. &6Tetrahedrite&f veins are higher up, while &6Chalcopyrite&f veins are lower, paired with some small amounts of &6Iron&f. You'll also find &6Malachite&f inside of Iron veins; this is another type of copper ore.
moni.quest.7DE2C9292A09FC76.description6: In &6HV&r Age and more effectively in &9IV&r Age, you can also get this from processing &9Ender Air&r, which may be better than going to the moon, depending on your circumstances.&r
moni.quest.1229234A71CE0A99.description2: &6Copper&f: Two primary sources. &6Tetrahedrite&f veins are higher up, while &6Chalcopyrite&f veins are lower, paired with some small amounts of &6Iron&f. You'll also find &6Malachite&f inside of Iron veins; this is another type of copper ore.
moni.quest.061904A6FEED5B66.description2: It is primarily obtained by electrolyzing &6Ruby Dust&r. Alternatively you can process &6Ruby Ore&r for a small chance to get chromium. You can also mine &6Chromite&r in The End. You will need a lot of this soon, so be sure to accumulate a lot of it.
moni.quest.7DE2C9292A09FC76.description3: The Moon also contains fluid deposits of &eDeuterium&r and &eHelium-3&r, which you can harvest with a &3Fluid Rig&r. However, you will want to use the second Fluid Rig tier to extract it, as the amount of Deuterium and Helium-3 is too low to be anything appreciable from a first tier Fluid Rig.
moni.quest.7DE2C9292A09FC76.description7: There are also several ores that are rare on the Overworld but exist in abundance on the Moon. In particular, the Moon contains large quantities of &6Titanium&r, (in the form of &6Aluminium Ore&r and &6Ilmenite Ore&r) &6Chromium&r, (in the form of &6Chromite Ore&r) and &6Fluorine&r (in the form of &6Fluorite Ore&r).
moni.quest.75810A27FBBBFB77.description3: Naquadah Chemistry yields large amounts of a variety of valuable resources. It will serve as your primary source of radioactive elements such as &6Neptunium&r, &6Curium&r, and &6Berkelium&r, as well as providing quite a bit of other advanced materials such as &6Tritanium&r, &6Darmstadtium&r, and &6Neutronium&r.
moni.quest.4672EE66D51C32FF.description2: If you wish to create a base on the moon, it's worth looking into The &3Oxygen Distibutor&r and &9Oxygen Sensor&r. Later on, you can even create the &3Gravity Normalizer&r, which allows you to control gravity itself!
moni.quest.634E056463ED1532.description2: This alloy is cooked in an &3Electric Blast Furnace&r and cooled in a &3Vacuum Freezer&r.
moni.quest.5911900438648430.description1: As the most advanced polymer you will need to make, &6Polyethyl Cyanoacrylate&r is required for a few endgame crafts.
moni.quest.1229234A71CE0A99.description2: &6Copper&f: Two primary sources. &6Tetrahedrite&f veins are higher up, while &6Chalcopyrite&f veins are lower, paired with some small amounts of &6Iron&f. You'll also find &6Malachite&f inside of Iron veins; this is another type of copper ore.
